findings.evidence: Lines 186-197: `set c := deriv φ (φ.symm w)`, `have hre := congrArg Complex.re hcc`, `have him := ...`, `have hJJ ...`, `linear_combination (norm := module) hre • η w (u w) - him • J w (u w) (η w (u w))`.
findings.fix: Add a lemma, e.g. `(c.re • x - c.im • J x)` composed with the `d` transform equals `(d*c).re • x - (d*c).im • J x` for `J ∘ J = -id`, and use it with `inv_mul_cancel₀`.
findings.issue: The reason the two η-transformations cancel (multiplicativity of `a + b i ↦ a - b J` when `J² = -1`, cited in the docstrings) is not a lemma. It is rebuilt inline from `hre`/`him` (re/im of `c⁻¹ * c = 1`), `hJJ`, and `linear_combination (norm := module)`, so the reusable fact stays hidden.

findings.fix: Use `by simp [φ]` / `by simp [Ψ]` (or `Opens.coe_top`, `Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph_source`), or pass `Ω := ⊤` and rewrite `Opens.coe_top` explicitly.
findings.issue: `fun _ _ => trivial` closes `φ x ∈ ↑(⊤ : Opens ℂ)` and `fun _ _ => mem_univ _` (line 127) closes `_ ∈ Ψ.source`. Both depend on definitional unfolding (coercion of `⊤ : Opens`, the `let`-bound `Homeomorph.toOpenPartialHomeomorph` source) with no comment.

findings.fix: Close it in one step with `simp [conjCLE_apply]` or `norm_num [conjCLE_apply]`, without depending on the residual goal shape.
findings.issue: The term goal is closed by `norm_num` followed by `exact conjCLE.symm_apply_eq.2 (by rw [conjCLE_apply, map_ofNat])`. That only fits the specific goal `norm_num` leaves, so it breaks whenever the simp set changes.

summary: The reverse direction of the domain equivalence buries its key algebraic fact, multiplicativity of `a + b i ↦ a - b J` under `J² = -1`, in a coefficient computation instead of a lemma. The dilation example relies on undocumented defeq for set membership and ends on a step that only fits the goal `norm_num` happens to leave.
